title: Egg Frittata with Hash Browns and Bacon

source.section: Egg Frittata with Hash Browns and Bacon

ingredients.text: 2 个甜椒（颜色自选），去蒂、去籽、切碎
2 cups 冷冻薯饼土豆丝（hash brown potatoes）

steps.text: 移开锅盖。旋钮转至 SEAR/SAUTÉ，温度设为 HI，按 START/STOP 开始预热。预热 5 分钟。
steps.originalText: Remove the lid from the pot. Turn dial to SEAR/SAUTÉ, set temperature to HI, and press START/STOP to begin preheating. Allow the unit to preheat for 5 minutes.

steps.text: 预热完成后，将培根加入锅中，不盖盖烹饪 12 分钟，经常搅拌。
steps.originalText: When preheating is complete, add bacon to the pot and cook uncovered for 12 minutes, stirring frequently.

steps.text: 将洋葱和甜椒加入锅中，不盖盖烹饪 5 分钟，期间搅拌两次。
steps.originalText: Add onion and peppers to the pot and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring twice.

steps.text: 将薯饼土豆丝加入锅中，搅拌混合，然后盖盖烹饪 5 分钟。
steps.originalText: Add hash brown potatoes to the pot. Stir to combine, then cover with the lid and cook for 5 minutes.

steps.text: 食材烹饪时，在大碗中将鸡蛋、牛奶和奶酪搅打混合。
steps.originalText: While ingredients cook, whisk together the eggs, milk, and cheese in a large bowl until combined.

steps.text: 将蛋液混合物、盐和胡椒加入锅中，搅拌混合，然后盖盖。
steps.originalText: Add the egg mixture, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine, then cover with the lid.

steps.text: 旋钮转至 BAKE，温度设为 300°F，时间设为 30 分钟。按 START/STOP 继续烹饪。
steps.originalText: Turn dial to BAKE, set temperature to 300°F, and set time to 30 minutes. Press START/STOP to continue cooking.

steps.text: 烹饪完成后，用橡胶头锅铲立即盛出蛋饼。
steps.originalText: When cooking is complete, use a rubber-tipped spatula to immediately serve the frittata.

tips.text: 第 5 步的切达奶酪可换成自选的奶酪丝、磨碎奶酪或碎奶酪。菲达奶酪也可做出美味蛋饼。

safetyWarnings.text: 注意：Sear/Sauté 会达到高温。无人看管时，食物可能烧焦。触碰热表面及取出食物时应小心，以免烫伤。使用 Sear/Sauté 时不要盖盖，不要让机器无人看管。
煎肉和炒菜时应小心。手和脸要远离可拆卸内锅，尤其是添加新食材时，因为热油可能飞溅。

title: Cherry Maple Oatmeal

ingredients.text: 2 cups 去核干樱桃或新鲜樱桃

steps.text: 将牛奶、枫糖浆、黄油、香草精、肉桂、肉豆蔻和盐放入锅中。搅拌混合，然后盖盖。
steps.originalText: Place the milk, maple syrup, butter, vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in the pot. Stir to combine, then cover with the lid.

steps.text: 旋钮转至 SEAR/SAUTÉ，温度设为 HI，按 START/STOP 开始烹饪。烹饪 10 分钟。
steps.originalText: Turn dial to SEAR/SAUTÉ, set temperature to HI, and press START/STOP to begin cooking. Allow ingredients to cook for 10 minutes.

steps.text: 10 分钟后，将燕麦加入锅中，搅拌混合，然后盖盖。
steps.originalText: After 10 minutes, add the oats to the pot. Stir to combine, then cover with the lid.

steps.text: 旋钮转至 SLOW COOK，温度设为 HI，时间设为 3 小时。
steps.originalText: Turn dial to SLOW COOK, set temperature to HI, and set time to 3 hours.

steps.text: 烹饪完成后，加入樱桃并搅拌混合。立即食用。
steps.originalText: When cooking is complete, add cherries to the pot and stir to combine. Serve immediately.

tips.text: 可将 2 cups 干樱桃换成 2 cups 干果或冷冻水果，例如蓝莓、草莓或覆盆子。

title: Simple Focaccia

ingredients.text: 16 ounces 现成披萨面团，室温
2 tablespoons 特级初榨橄榄油，另备一些供食用时使用

steps.text: 将披萨面团揉成球，再压成 4-inch 圆饼。在面团顶部和锅内轻喷烹饪喷雾。
steps.originalText: Roll the pizza dough into a ball, then flatten the ball into a 4-inch disc. Lightly spray the top of the dough and the inside of the pot with cooking spray.

steps.text: 将面团放入锅中，然后盖盖。
steps.originalText: Place the dough in the pot, then cover with the lid.

steps.text: 旋钮转至 PROOF，时间设为 60 分钟，温度设为 95°F。按 START/STOP 开始发酵。
steps.originalText: Turn dial to PROOF, set time to 60 minutes, and set temperature to 95°F. Press START/STOP to begin proofing.

steps.text: 面团发酵时，将传统烤箱预热至 425°F。
steps.originalText: While the dough is proofing, preheat conventional oven to 425°F.

steps.text: 发酵完成后移开锅盖，用手指将面团均匀铺满锅底表面。轻轻多次按压面团，形成凹坑。
steps.originalText: When proofing is complete, remove the lid. Use fingers to spread dough evenly across surface area of pot. Gently press fingers into dough multiple times to create dimples in the dough.

steps.text: 将橄榄油、迷迭香、盐和胡椒均匀撒在面团上。
steps.originalText: Sprinkle the oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper evenly over the dough.

steps.text: 将整个内锅（不带锅盖）放入传统烤箱，烘烤 18 分钟，直到面包呈浅金黄色。
steps.originalText: Place the entire pot (without the lid) in the conventional oven and bake for 18 minutes, until focaccia is lightly golden.

steps.text: 烹饪完成后，从烤箱取出内锅。趁热食用或放凉至室温食用，可按需另配橄榄油。
steps.originalText: When cooking is complete, remove the pot from the oven. Serve hot or cooled to room temperature with additional olive oil as desired.

tips.text: 想增加变化，可在第 6 步将洋葱片、切碎的日晒番茄和／或绿橄榄放在面团上。

safetyWarnings.text: 不要使用 SharkNinja 未推荐或未销售的配件。不要将配件放入微波炉、台式烤箱、热风烤箱、传统烤箱，也不要放在陶瓷炉面、电热盘、燃气炉或户外烤架上。使用未经推荐的配件可能引起火灾、触电或受伤。
注意：热锅可能损坏台面或桌面。将热内锅从机器中取出时，不要直接放在没有保护的表面上。始终放在隔热垫或架子上。
烹饪中或刚结束时不要触碰配件，因为配件会非常热。为防烫伤或其他伤害，操作产品时始终小心。使用长柄器具、防烫垫或隔热烤箱手套。

title: Deviled Eggs

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon 烟熏红椒粉，另备一些作装饰

steps.text: 将水放入锅中，然后盖盖。
steps.originalText: Place water in the pot, then cover with the lid.

steps.text: 旋钮转至 STEAM，时间设为 20 分钟，按 START/STOP 开始预热。
steps.originalText: Turn dial to STEAM, set time to 20 minutes, and press START/STOP to begin preheating.

steps.text: 预热完成后，移开锅盖，轻轻将鸡蛋放入锅中，然后盖盖。
steps.originalText: When preheating is complete, remove the lid and gently place the eggs in the pot, then cover with the lid.

steps.text: 鸡蛋烹饪时，在大碗中按需加入水和冰，准备冰浴。
steps.originalText: While the eggs are cooking, prepare an ice bath by adding water and ice to a large bowl, as needed.

steps.text: 烹饪完成后，将鸡蛋从锅中取出并放入冰浴，确保鸡蛋完全浸没。冰浴至少 15 分钟，以停止烹饪过程。
steps.originalText: When cooking is complete, remove the eggs from the pot and transfer to ice bath, ensuring the eggs are fully submerged. Leave the eggs in the ice bath for at least 15 minutes to stop the cooking process.

steps.text: 鸡蛋冷却时，将所有剩余食材放入一个大碗中。
steps.originalText: While the eggs are cooling, place all remaining ingredients in a large bowl.

steps.text: 鸡蛋完全冷却后，在冷水下剥壳。
steps.originalText: When the eggs are completely cooled, peel them under cold water to remove the shells.

steps.text: 将去壳鸡蛋切成两半。轻轻挖出蛋黄，放入一个中碗，与所有剩余食材放在一起。
steps.originalText: Cut the peeled eggs in half. Gently scoop the yolks out of the halved eggs and place into a medium bowl with all remaining ingredients.

steps.text: 搅打食材至少 30 秒，或直到完全混合、质地顺滑。
steps.originalText: Whisk the ingredients together for at least 30 seconds or until fully combined and smooth in consistency.

steps.text: 将蛋黄混合物装入可重复密封的塑料袋，剪掉袋子一角。在每半个蛋白中挤入约 1½ tablespoons 馅料，填至高出蛋白。
steps.originalText: Transfer the egg mixture to a resealable plastic bag. Cut off a corner of the plastic bag and pipe approx. 11/2 tablespoons of filling into each egg half, overstuffing each.

steps.text: 按需另撒红椒粉装饰，即可食用。
steps.originalText: Garnish the deviled eggs with additional paprika as desired and serve.

tips.text: 在第 5 步，可用白葡萄酒醋或苹果醋替换腌黄瓜汁。

title: Butternut Squash & Bacon Risotto
titleZh: 奶油南瓜培根意式烩饭

steps.text: 旋钮转至 SEAR/SAUTÉ，温度设为 HI，按 START/STOP 开始预热。预热 5 分钟。
steps.originalText: Turn dial to SEAR/SAUTÉ, set temperature to HI, and press START/STOP to begin preheating. Allow the unit to preheat for 5 minutes.

steps.text: 预热完成后，将培根加入锅中，不盖盖烹饪 10 分钟，偶尔搅拌。
steps.originalText: When preheating is complete, add the bacon to the pot and cook uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.text: 将洋葱加入锅中，不盖盖烹饪 5 分钟，偶尔搅拌。
steps.originalText: Add the onion to the pot and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.text: 将高汤、米、南瓜和鼠尾草加入锅中。充分搅拌混合，然后盖盖。
steps.originalText: Add the stock, rice, squash, and sage to the pot. Stir the ingredients until well combined, then cover with the lid.

steps.text: 烹饪米混合物 35 分钟，偶尔搅拌。
steps.originalText: Cook the rice mixture for 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.text: 烹饪完成后，按 START/STOP 结束烹饪。移开锅盖，加入帕尔马干酪并搅拌混合。不盖盖静置 5 分钟。趁热食用。
